nodes.description: Private total token supply counter of the ERC20 implementation; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Private mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount storing spend approvals; written by _approve.
Private token name string, written once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private token symbol string, written once in the ERC20 constructor.
Private uint8 token decimals value, defaulted to 18 in the constructor.
Deployable constructor of MockERC20 that forwards name and symbol to ERC20 and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
Internal function creating amount tokens for account, increasing _totalSupply and _balances; internally unrestricted.
Internal transfer routine moving amount between _balances entries and firing the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
External ERC20 transfer; forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
External spender-driven transfer; performs _transfer then decreases the caller allowance via _approve.
External approval setter; delegates to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
External helper atomically increasing the caller allowance for spender using SafeMath.add.
External helper atomically decreasing the caller allowance for spender using SafeMath.sub.
Internal function writing the _allowances mapping and emitting Approval; validates zero addresses only.
Internal function destroying amount tokens from account, reducing _balances and _totalSupply.
External view returning the value of _totalSupply.
External view returning _balances[account] for an arbitrary address.
External view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
External view returning the _name state variable.
External view returning the _symbol state variable.
External view returning the _decimals state variable.
Internal view helper returning the raw msg.sender value.
Empty internal hook invoked before every mint, transfer and burn; overridable by derived contracts.
Caller-supplied address used as mint beneficiary, transfer sender, approve owner and allowance spender.
Unrestricted token minting entry point: _mint performs no caller authorisation, so any reachable caller path can create supply.
Constructor string parameter carrying the token name.
Constructor string parameter carrying the token symbol.
Constructor uint256 parameter carrying the initial supply minted to the deployer.
Destination address of newly minted tokens inside _mint.
Quantity of tokens created inside _mint and added to supply and balance.
Recipient address of the external transfer call.
Amount of tokens moved by the external transfer call.

edges.reason: Constructor name parameter is stored into the _name state variable.
Constructor symbol parameter is stored into the _symbol state variable.
Supply parameter enters the MockERC20 constructor and drives the initial mint.
The constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender without any restriction, granting the deployer the full balance.
The MockERC20 constructor invokes ERC20._mint.
The supply constructor argument is forwarded as the amount argument of _mint.
msg.sender is passed as the account argument of _mint.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable (SafeMath guarded).
_mint increases the _balances entry of the destination account.
_mint performs no caller authorisation, so minting is an unrestricted privilege operation.
The account parameter is the mint destination inside _mint.
The amount parameter is the minted quantity inside _mint.
The minted amount is added to _totalSupply.
The account parameter indexes the _balances mapping in _mint.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
The recipient parameter is forwarded into _transfer.
The amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer.
_msgSender() supplies the sender argument for _transfer inside transfer.
_transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
The transferred amount is subtracted from one balance and added to the other.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the allowance reduction to _approve.
_msgSender() is used as the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_msgSender() is used as the owner of the allowance in approve.
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
_burn decreases the _balances entry of the burned account.
_burn decreases _totalSupply (SafeMath guarded).
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping for the supplied account.
allowance reads the _allowances nested mapping.
name returns the _name state variable.
symbol returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals returns the _decimals state variable.
_msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating supply.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
